claim_reviews.rationale: Janssens 2018 reports Bonn burial and interprets illness and care; earlier dogs and initial domestication place remain unresolved, so first_known was appropriately removed.

claim_reviews.rationale: Roffet-Salque 2019 §9.3.3.3 and §9.3.4 and Fig. 9.6 report dairy-bearing sieves in both phases. Smyth 2023 §2.2 supplies 68% context ranges, not direct dates of sherds.

Established uses_process from Ludwinowo cattle husbandry to site dairy straining is supported as a local, probabilistic milk-source inference: Osypińska 2019 cattle remains, Roffet-Salque 2019 sieve lipids, Smyth 2023 §§3.3, 3.5, 4 cattle teeth. These are complementary material streams; Smyth repeats prior sieve measurements. The link direction and local phase context are appropriate; individual milk species remains uncertain. No transmission asserted.

additional_records.rationale: A distinct local husbandry practice from sieve processing; no duplicate discovered.

claim_reviews.rationale: Osypińska 2019 §7.1.4 and Smyth 2023 §§3.3–3.5 and 4 support predominantly cattle, interpreted mixed meat and milk economy, seasonal calving and phase III older-animal retention.
Smyth 2023 §§2.2–2.4 and 3.3–3.5 dates the site and phases and identifies isotopic and mortality evidence. 68% phase bounds and unknown individual sex and use are acknowledged.

locators: pp. 88–91, Fig. 3, Tables 1–3
source_checks.independence: Primary measurements of cattle bones, previously cited indirectly through Arbuckle and Kassebaum.

source_checks.independence: Primary direct specimen dates and nuclear genomes from Pınarbaşı and Gough’s Cave, distinct from the Bonn-Oberkassel material.

locators: pp. 90–94, Figs. 7.1–7.2 and text on Bos
source_checks.independence: Chapter compares original faunal measurements from Mehrgarh, Nausharo and Harappa. The quoted chronological framework predates the new Mehrgarh enamel dates.

locators: pp. 3–4, Fig. 2 and Discussion: The dating and duration of Mehrgarh Period I
source_checks.independence: New radiocarbon measurements on human dental enamel from the Period I cemetery and a Bayesian analysis. The tooth samples are independent of the material examined by Moulherat and colleagues.
Original zooarchaeological report on bones and teeth, distinct specimens and authors from the sherd lipid study.
Site-specific organic-residue analysis. Reuses Salque et al. 2013 measurements for sieves and adds new analyses mostly from other vessel forms; distinct evidence stream from the bones.

locators: Sections 2.1–2.4, 3.1, 3.3–3.5 and 4; Figs. 3 and 6–9
source_checks.independence: Integrated analysis combines cattle mortality profiles and tooth isotopes with ceramics. The tooth isotopes build on Kendall et al. 2019, and the sherd results include Salque et al. 2013 and the expanded 2019 assemblage.

locators: Abstract; Results; Discussion, The Domesticatory Process at Aşıklı Höyük
source_checks.independence: Expanded faunal study of the Aşıklı sequence with excavator overlap with the 2014 study. Includes Level 5 and reassesses caprine management through time.

Mutin 2025 original publication PDF inspected online, independent of researcher-authored notes.
duplicate_screen: Compared baseline event arrays and matched endpoints: Aşıklı initial Level 5 estimate is distinct from prior upper Level 4 event; Dongodien dairy adds a distinct site observation to regional herding; Ludwinowo sieve episode refines site and phases of broad Kuyavia event. New Ludwinowo husbandry is a separate local practice from straining, with no duplicate in discovery search.
unknowns: Milk species for individual sieves and regional transmission pathways remain unresolved.
The 68% Ludwinowo ranges are phase models, not direct dates for each object.
